items.name: ahmed-body
items.label: Ahmed body
items.about: The standard test shape for car aerodynamics: a box with a rounded nose and a 25° slanted rear, measured in wind tunnels many times. A half model at 40 m/s over a moving ground.

sizes.name: coarse
sizes.label: Coarse
sizes.about: for a quick look; its drag comes out 7 % above the medium mesh's

sizes.name: medium
sizes.label: Medium
sizes.about: the accuracy check's mesh, with drag within 2 % of the wind tunnel's

sizes.name: fine
sizes.label: Fine
sizes.about: twice the medium mesh's cells, for the same drag

items.name: wheel-wing
items.label: Wheel and front wing
items.about: A front wing in ground effect ahead of a rolling 18-inch wheel, with the forces on each part. A full model at 15 m/s over a moving ground; your own parts can take the demo geometry's place.
